guidance: The only available next node is the Rest Site before the Act 1 boss. At 30/80 HP, HEAL rather than upgrade a card: another 24 HP of immediate survival is more valuable than a modest single-card improvement for the imminent boss. Preserve the Duplicator potion for a high-impact boss attack or emergency defense. Resolve the rest and stop at the next MAP; if options differ, use their actual displayed effects and favor survival.
